same_template_pairs.instruction_a: task: estimate peanut area index calculate a peanut area (pa) index for cropland in jilin province, china, using time series evi2 and ari indices derived from sentinel-2 imagery in 2019. it first processes evi2 data to identify the day of maximum vegetation growth via qualitymosaic, then masks ari (anthocyanin reflectance index) images to the pre-growing and growing periods relative to this peak. from the masked ari time series, it computes the difference between max and min ari, standard deviation, and cumulative negative change during the growing period. these metrics are multiplied to generate the pa index, which is masked to cropland areas (jl_cropland) and scaled by 100. the output is a raster image representing the pa index, exported to earth engine asset with a resolution of 20 meters.
